pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Pure Perl cluster library modules: PVE::Corosync (config parse/write), PVE::DataCenterConfig (datacenter.cfg schema), PVE::RRD (metrics, requires net-analyzer/rrdtool[perl,graph]), PVE::SSHInfo (key/fingerprint helpers), PVE::Notify (notification dispatcher using Proxmox::RS::Notify).
Merges Debian's libpve-cluster-perl and libpve-notify-perl into one package. RDEPEND on net-analyzer/rrdtool[perl,graph] is mandatory (graph USE is required when perl USE is enabled, per rrdtool ebuild).
